title: Picture Chain

serves.summary: The child drags picture cards into a row of boxes to order them along a scale (smallest to biggest by the real thing, freezing to hot) or a chain where each step leads to the next (seed to bee, egg to hen), leaving out a picture that does not belong, which shows understanding of words for degrees of size and temperature and of how related ideas connect in order.

request.topic: Ordering pictures along a scale or a chain
request.objective: Put pictures in order along a scale (tiny to huge, freezing to hot) by the real things, not their drawn size, or along a chain where each step leads to the next, leaving out a picture that does not belong. (LA005-01-H, LA005-03-H)

problems.ask: Put the fish in order from the smallest to the biggest.
problems.goal: Small, middle, big along the arrow. Copying the tray (middle, small, big) is the miss.

problems.ask: Put the animals in order from the tiniest to the hugest.
problems.goal: Ant, mouse, dog, elephant by the real animals' size. The pictures are drawn the other way round (the ant biggest), so ordering by drawn size is the miss.

problems.ask: Put the pictures in order from freezing cold to very hot.
problems.goal: Ice, rain, beach, fire. Getting the two ends right and swapping the middle (beach before rain) is the miss.

params.scale: a chain: each picture leads to the next

problems.ask: These pictures show how a seed ends up feeding a bee. Put them in order.
problems.goal: Seed, sprout, flower, bee. Starting the chain at the flower is the miss.
